title: Add more audio and video signatures
body: Add signatures for FLAC, HLS playlists, Matroska, AAC in ADTS, and MPEG-TS, and recognize more MP4 brands, matching Gecko. The Canon CR3 brand is excluded so CR3 files aren't sniffed as MP4. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64714. Fixes #149. *** This is needed for opaque-response blocking (whatwg/fetch#1755), which blocks unlabeled responses to media requests unless they sniff as audio or video. Differences from Gecko's `nsMediaSniffer.cpp`: a `crx` major brand returns false (Gecko returns `application/octet-stream`, which ORB treats as a match), ADTS requires a frame length of at least 7, and `avif` isn't included as it's an image.
